This scene:
古代的时候，一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。他很喜欢他的城市，但是城市有才两个学校，都很小。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候：在古代
- 但是城市有才两个学校：这个城市，只有

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “古代的时候” / Formula: 在 + historical time period / Correct: “在古代”   “古代的时候” is understandable, but “在古代” is more natural and concise.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。” / Formula: 有一个 + 叫 + name + 的 + noun / Correct: “在古代，有一个叫孟子的男孩子和他的妈妈住在中国。”   Introduce an important character by name when he first appears. Also, “和” is more neutral than “跟” here.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “孟子老是祭拜” / Formula: Subject + 一直/常常 + verb + object / Correct: “孟子常常祭拜祖先。”   “老是” often expresses annoyance or criticism (“keeps doing something”), so it does not fit this neutral description. “祭拜” also usually needs an object, such as “祖先”.
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “城市有才两个学校” / Formula: Place + 里 + 才 + 有 + number + measure word + noun / Correct: “城里才有两所学校。”   Put “才” before “有,” and use the measure word “所” for schools.

items.reason: “古代的时候” is redundant under the teacher's rule, and “在古代” correctly fixes it.
The original introduction is already grammatical and the pronoun “他” clearly refers to the immediately preceding boy.
“老是祭拜” is understandable and acceptable here, so adding “祖先” and replacing “老是” is unnecessary.
The original has incorrect “有才” order and lacks the appropriate school measure word; “城里才有两所学校” is grammatical.
